scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street corner with a yellow building featuring arched windows and a flat roof, situated across the street from a large building with a black sign reading 'R' in white letters. Two women cross the street in front of the yellow building, while a person walks down the sidewalk behind them. The street is paved with asphalt and has a crosswalk marked by white lines and a red pole. A metal fence encloses a small garden area to the left of the street. The sky is overcast.
scene_analysis.buildings: The yellow building has a cream-colored facade with numerous arched windows and a flat roof. It stands at least six stories tall and has a large window on the ground floor. The adjacent building is taller and has a black sign reading 'R' in white letters. The two women are dressed in casual attire, with one wearing blue shorts and the other wearing a white dress. A person in orange clothing walks down the sidewalk behind them.

The adjacent building is made of concrete and has a flat roof. The street is paved with asphalt and has a crosswalk marked by white lines and a red pole. A metal fence encloses a small garden area to the left of the street.

scene_analysis.vegetation: There are some trees and plants along the sidewalk, but they are sparse and do not appear healthy. There are also some bushes and flowers in the garden area.
